description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a "Ratio" and a metric labeled "minFDE_20 (↓)" for five different data series, four of which are labeled "Head Tuning," "FT," "LoRA 16," and "LoRA 64," while the first legend entry is obscured by a gray rectangle. The x-axis represents the "Ratio" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents "minFDE_20 (↓)" on a linear scale, ranging from 18 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The obscured first entry is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it shows a steady decline from approximately 20.4 at an x-value of 0.1 to 18.05 at an x-value of 1.0, passing through 19.2 at x=0.3 and 18.6 at x=0.5. The "Head Tuning" series is a solid orange line with circular markers, starting at roughly 23.0 at x=0.1, experiencing minor fluctuations such as a dip to 22.55 at x=0.5 and a slight rise to 22.7 at x=0.7, before ending at 22.6 at x=1.0. The "FT" series, shown as a solid green line with circular markers, begins at 22.25 at x=0.1, drops to 21.75 at x=0.2, rises to 22.0 at x=0.3, declines to 20.65 at x=0.7 where it remains steady until x=0.9, and finally rises to 21.0 at x=1.0. The "LoRA 16" series is a solid red line with circular markers that starts at 23.0 at x=0.1, steadily decreases to 22.05 at x=0.9, and slightly increases to end at 22.2 at x=1.0. Finally, the "LoRA 64" series is a solid purple line with circular markers, beginning at 22.95 at x=0.1 and following a steady downward trend to reach 22.1 at x=0.9, concluding at 22.15 at x=1.0.
